mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 1.0% signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue visibility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST grow >1.0% over prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly unemployment decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market recovery, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines >0.2pp and UNRATE >5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions, suppressing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE >5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate rises (UNRATE) signal ineffective monetary policy during labor market stress, depressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit balance (RSAFS) above $500 billion indicates strong household spending capacity, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds $500 billion over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 105.0), a monthly industrial production decline exceeding 0.5 points signals supply chain disruption, reducing corporate output and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines >0.5pp and INDPRO <105.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
